newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish wood firm postpones IPO until January 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish wood firm postpones IPO until January 1997.

text.p: Polish wood panel producer Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA (Grajewo) postponed its initial public offering until next year, possibly January, from the earlier planned December 1996, Grajewo said in a statement.
Grajewo, which is seeking a main market listing, said it decided to postpone the 550,000-share issue because it wanted to wait for a better investment climate on the Warsaw bourse.
The market has fallen about 10 percent to 13,619.6 points on Monday, since recording a high on October 9.
Grajewo said it would announce the precise subscription period by December 2.
The firm made a net profit of 12.4 million zlotys last year on sales of 195.7 million zlotys.
